headline: Two Republican Guards Collapse During Elysee Palace Welcome Ceremony
seoTitle: French Guards Collapse at Elysee Palace
metaDescription: Two members of France's Republican Guard fell during an official welcome ceremony for the Slovak president at the Elysee Palace in Paris.
aiSummaryBullets: Two elite Republican Guards fainted during a state arrival ceremony.
The incident occurred at the Elysee Palace while President Emmanuel Macron greeted the Slovak president.
Footage of the event showed the two guards falling nearly at the same time.
aiContextParagraph: The incident took place during an official state function held at the Elysee Palace, the residence and office of the French President in Paris. As President Emmanuel Macron prepared to receive the visiting president of Slovakia, two members of the Republican Guard—a specialized unit tasked with protecting government institutions and officials—lost consciousness and collapsed. Televised images confirmed that the two guards fell almost simultaneously while standing in formation during the ceremonial proceedings. A source from the presidential office acknowledged the occurrence, though no further details regarding the health of the individuals or the specific circumstances leading to their collapse have been disclosed in initial reports. The Republican Guard remains a significant fixture in French state ceremonies, frequently standing in prolonged, rigid formation during high-profile diplomatic arrivals involving foreign heads of state.
whyItIsViral: The event gained attention due to the unusual nature of the synchronized collapse involving high-profile government security during a televised state ceremony.
